title: Serene Room in East Nashville | Pool Access
description:
Step into a mid-century retreat at Salt Ranch, East Nashville’s newest boutique motor inn. Our Deluxe King room features floor-to-ceiling windows, custom robes, and 55-inch TVs. Guests enjoy full access to the Swim Club, our historic 1856 Main House bar, and a library bodega. Located just 10 minutes from Broadway and Nissan Stadium, we offer free parking and the true spirit of Music City.

The space
This listing is for a room within a hotel.

✦ Your room is 312 sq. ft, equipped with complimentary toiletries, standard quality 55-inch TV, available with Standard cable.

✦ Cleaning services included in the nightly price.

There are a few additional details to know before you book:

✦ The minimum age required for check-in is 21 years old.

✦ Please ensure you have a valid ID for check-in, as it is mandatory for entry.

Guest access
During your stay, you will have access to the property and amenities according to the following schedule:

✦ Check-in is available from 3:00PM, and is flexible afterwards. If you expect to arrive later, please let us know as soon as possible to make the necessary arrangements.

✦ You may keep your luggage at the front desk if you arrive early.

✦ Outdoor shared pool available from May 15 to October 15, opened from 10:00AM to 7:00PM.

✦ Free parking lot – 1 space(s).

Other things to note
There are several additional things to note:

✦ A valid credit or debit card is required for the refundable security deposit and any offline fees displayed upon completing your Airbnb reservation.

✦ Please note that the mandatory resort fee is charged per night, per unit which will be collected in person at check-in.

✦ Pets are welcome. Welcoming dogs and cats only

✦ We use multi-unit listings, so rooms are similar but may have small differences.

✦ Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability for a fee.

✦ Pack 'n' play; subject to availability, upon request

✦ A smoking penalty will apply for smoking outside the property's designated smoking areas.
